newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Nice to buy Canadian company.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Nice to buy Canadian company.

text.p: Nice Systems Ltd said on Thursday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire Canadian based Dees Communications for $8 million in cash and up to 500,000 ordinary shares of Nice.
Nice said in a statement this was a "move towards becoming a dominant player in the call center logging and monitoring market".

The letter of intent is subject to entering into a definitive agreement, which is expected to be signed by July following approval by Nice's board of directors and Dees' shareholders and regulatory approvals.

Nice intends to acquire all the outstanding shares and stock of Dees. In addition to the $8 million in cash Nice will issue between 435,000 and 500,000 ordinary shares, depending on the share price at the closing, the Israeli company said.
Nice shares on Nasdaq closed at $26-3/4 on Wednesday.

"In line with our strategy to focus on the call center market, the acquisition of Dees will provide Nice with an enhanced presence in the U.S. and Canadian call center markets, areas where Nice already has a strong position in the total logging market, and strengthen the company's sales and marketing channels throughout North America," said Nice president Benny Levin.

Dees, a privately held company, provides automated call center monitoring solutions while Nice provides CTI (computer telephony integrated) logging, monitoring and management solutions for voice, fax and data.
